definition: a document listing the choices you vote for
description: Inside a school hall set up with cardboard privacy screens, a clear plastic box already half full of folded white papers stands on a table. A woman in a yellow blouse posts her folded paper through the slot in the lid and smiles. A tattooed young man walks up the aisle holding his paper and drops it in, watched by the queue behind him. An older man in a striped polo shirt pushes his paper through the slot, then a woman in a wheelchair reaches up and posts hers. The queue keeps moving and an official sits at a desk beside the box.
